attribution_text: Data from ESA's Gaia mission, processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC).
cache_ttl: not applicable to immutable repository artifact.
failure_and_fallback_behaviour: fail closed; no live fallback or unrelated data.
fetch_time_policy: exact DataManifest retrieval time becomes source-record fetched_at.
fixture_and_checksum_strategy: approved 747-byte CSV plus exact SHA-256; fictional fixtures are test-only.
known_limitations: five exact Gaia DR3 source IDs only; this slice is not representative of Gaia DR3.
positions are accepted at the published Gaia reference epoch; no proper-motion or epoch propagation is performed.
observation_or_publication_time_policy: Gaia DR3 astrometric parameters retain their published Julian-year reference epoch; no observation-time or propagated position is fabricated.
purpose: ingest one offline, checksum-pinned Gaia DR3 ICRS astrometry slice from gaiadr3.gaia_source.
rate_or_fair_use_constraints: one bounded reviewed acquisition; runtime and CI make no requests.
refresh_schedule: none; release and bytes are pinned.
